result.summary: Neither candidate is established: required claims C2 and C3 remain unresolved, and neither has required support beyond annotation. C1 supports that the variant overlaps EH38E3622530, but does not show an allelic effect. The reported C228T reporter result remains a discovery lead because its identity with the case variant has not been established; no variant-level molecular effect or TERT expression association is supported here.

next_experiments.text: In a relevant TERT-expressing cellular context, compare otherwise matched G and A alleles at the exact case variant and measure regulatory activity of EH38E3622530. Confirm the variant identity and assay the endogenous element rather than relying only on a promoter-fragment reporter.

Test the exact variant in an expression-association dataset or matched isogenic system, reporting TERT expression by allele and the tissue or cellular context. This would test the expression-association hypothesis but would not by itself establish causation.

uninvestigated_questions: Q2: Has primary literature on rs1242535815 or the exact locus 5:1295113 reported an experiment comparing the G and A alleles for regulatory activity or another molecular effect?

Q5: Does the relevant TERT promoter-mechanism review cite a primary study that tests the promoter mutation corresponding to rs1242535815 (C228T; the case G>A alleles) in a mutant-versus-reference regulatory-activity assay? Identify the cited reference and any details that distinguish an exact-variant allele comparison from discussion or prediction. Treat the review as a discovery pointer, not evidence for C2.

audit.verdict: Primary reporter evidence was discovered but not accepted or adopted. The investigation ended with no supported molecular claim and unresolved promoter/activity and expression candidates.
audit.factor_recovery: No supported GABPA claim; reporter remained a lead
notes: Only chr5:1295113 G>A and somatic origin were supplied. Variant annotation independently returned rs1242535815. The supplied variant was not labelled C228T in the agent request.

The literature route followed a review to Huang et al. (2013; PMID 23348506, PMC4423787). The paper reports increased mutant promoter reporter activity; its result paragraph uses C228T/C250T shorthand, with coordinates defined elsewhere in the article.

D38 and D43 refused extraction because the coordinate supplied in about_variants was absent from the selected result paragraph and the article mentioned multiple variants. The follow-up did not produce a source-backed local-name mapping or verify the GRCh37/GRCh38 and strand crosswalk to the case.

Even with identity resolved, reporter activity is not the same endpoint as endogenous EH38E3622530 activity. A refined reporter-scoped claim could preserve the finding while leaving the endogenous claim unresolved. No such refinement was accepted in this run.
The expected GABP study (Bell et al., 2015; PMID 25977370) was not read. QBiC ETS predictions and GABPA mentions are not evidence-linked GABPA recovery.
CIViC returned a GraphQL schema error; GTEx had no genotype for this variant. Neither outcome is biological negative evidence.
17 model calls, 15 tools and 8 literature reads cost $0.031657. The investigation stopped at the model-call reservation guard, then completed audit and comparison. No live rerun was performed.
